title: σωτηρία ἀπὸ Λύκου
learning_goal: Practice first/second person statements, vocatives with ὦ, simple imperatives (including μὴ), and explicit subjects/objects in present-tense narration.
plot: Glaux and Panda play ball by the tree until Lukos threatens them; Hyperbrephos hears, races out, saves them with a thrown stone, and they happily play again.
